- **Test image:** Banana leaf entirely yellowed (golden-yellow) with dark brown/black linear streaks running along and between the veins, necrotic brown areas at lower portions
- **Yellow_And_Black_Sigatoka ref:** Discrete spots with yellow halos on green leaf (early stage) - dark streaks are consistent with the disease pattern, just less advanced stage shown

The key distinguishing feature is the dark brown/black streaks running parallel to the veins on a yellow leaf background. Panama Disease causes uniform internal vascular discoloration (not surface streaks), while Yellow/Black Sigatoka causes exactly this pattern - yellow tissue with dark necrotic streaks following vein lines. In advanced Sigatoka, the entire leaf can turn yellow with dark streaks - which matches the test image perfectly.
